newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA "SHOCKED" BY GUATEMALA STADIUM TRAGEDY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA "SHOCKED" BY GUATEMALA STADIUM TRAGEDY.

text.p: World soccer's governing body FIFA expressed shock on Thursday at "the huge tragedy" at a Guatemala stadium in which at least 79 people died and more than 150 were injured.

The tragedy happened when an avalanche of fans tumbled down stadium seats and a flight of stairs at a World Cup qualifying match between Guatemala and Costa Rica on Wednesday. The game was immediatly suspended.
International Football Federation (FIFA) spokesman Andreas Herren said: "Obviously this is a huge tragedy. All the people here at FIFA are shocked.
"We're just trying to piece this tragedy together and get as much information as possible. We have just sent our condolences to the Guatemalan Football Association.
"When we release a statement later today it will include some details of what happened from the FIFA match commission," Herren added.
"We want to wait until we have the complete picture. We are waiting for some reports and need to fill in just a few more details."
